title: Implement Service Area section variants (service-area-list, service-area-map)
description: Implement two Service Area variants. service-area-list shows a headline with a list/grid of area names. service-area-map shows a Google Maps embed alongside the area list.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: ServiceAreaContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Both render the headline and list of areas
service-area-map shows an iframe embed if mapEmbedUrl is provided, fallback to list-only if not
Areas are displayed as pill badges or bullet points
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Headline + description text. Areas as flex-wrap of pill badges (rounded, `--color-primary-light` background, `--color-primary` text). If more than 8 areas, show first 8 with a '+ X more' badge.

Two-column layout: map iframe on one side, area list on the other. If `content.mapEmbedUrl` is not provided, render `ServiceAreaList` layout instead. Map iframe: `sandbox='allow-scripts allow-same-origin'`, aspect ratio 4:3.
Take Playwright screenshot. Confirm areas display as pills, map renders if URL provided.
